**[Recall Knowledge - Humanoid](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)** ([Society](/Skills.aspx?ID=14)): DC 25 **[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 23 **[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 20 [Heldin Ulgincamp](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2608) **Source** [Pathfinder #193: Mantle of Gold](/Sources.aspx?ID=206) pg. 40 **Perception** +7; darkvision **Languages** [Common](/Languages.aspx?ID=1), [Dwarven](/Languages.aspx?ID=3), [Petran](/Languages.aspx?ID=109) **Skills** [Crafting](/Skills.aspx?ID=4) +7, [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=6) +5, [Religion](/Skills.aspx?ID=13) +8 **Str** +1 **Dex** +0 **Con** +1 **Int** +3 **Wis** +4 **Cha** +1 **Items** [candles](/Equipment.aspx?ID=10) (10), [Chain Shirt](/Armor.aspx?ID=6), [Flint and Steel](/Equipment.aspx?ID=21), [religious symbol](/Armor.aspx?ID=22), [Repair Kit](/Equipment.aspx?ID=43), [warhammer](/Equipment.aspx?ID=24) --- **AC** 16 **Fort** +7 **Ref** +4 **Will** +10 **HP** 20 --- **Speed** 20 feet **Melee** warhammer +7 ([Shove](/Traits.aspx?ID=193)), **Damage** 1d8+1 bludgeoning **Divine Prepared Spells** DC 17 - **Cantrips (1st)** [Chill Touch](/Spells.aspx?ID=35), [Shield](/Spells.aspx?ID=280), [Stabilize](/Spells.aspx?ID=307) - **1st** [Heal](/Spells.aspx?ID=148), [Magic Weapon](/Spells.aspx?ID=182) **Anchor the Unliving** ([Divine](/Traits.aspx?ID=48), [Necromancy](/Traits.aspx?ID=117)) Heldin displays their religious symbol at an undead creature within 30 feet. The creature must attempt a DC 17 Fortitude save. **Critical Success** The creature is unaffected
**Success** Reduce the creature’s resistances by 1 for 1d4 rounds, after which it’s immune to this ability for 1 round.
**Failure** As success, but the resistances are reduced by 3.
**Critical Failure** As success, but the resistances are reduced by 5.
